title: Add RBACv2 decision cache and audit-obligation middleware with KMS-region soft-fail
author: Marcel Nguyen
release_notes: Adds an opt-in RBACv2 decision cache and an audit-obligation middleware to surface per-request KMS region pinning evidence. Default behavior is opt-in and does not change runtime defaults; a feature flag gate is included.
description: Context: Customers and compliance teams have asked for stronger, low-latency enforcement telemetry around KMS region pinning and RBACv2 decisions. In high-throughput paths the policy evaluator (OPA / pdsvc) introduces measurable tail-latency that inflates request SLOs. This PR introduces a small, conservative RBACv2 decision cache and a complementary audit-obligation middleware that records the evaluator outcome and any KMS region pin assertions into the audit stream. Design goals: reduce evaluator calls for identical decision contexts, keep cache TTLs short, and ensure revocations/rollouts are visible. The cache is scope-aware (service, tenant, route, action) and TTL/size defaults are conservative. The audit-obligation middleware emits a "kms_residency_evidence" audit attribute when the decision or request triggers a residency/KMS region pin. Soft-fail mode: when the KMS-region lookup service is unavailable we now emit a structured audit entry and allow the request to continue (soft-fail) under a configurable policy per environment so that customer traffic is not blocked while still providing observability for post-hoc compliance checks. What changed (high level): - Add internal/rbac/decision_cache.go: a small LRU + TTL cache with revocation hooks and a metrics facade. - Add internal/audit/obligation_middleware.go: middleware that enriches the audit envelope with obligation attributes (kms_residency_evidence, decision_source, cache_hit). - Integrate cache into the existing policy evaluation path (authz/engine.go) with an explicit opt-in flag for each service via config. - Add pkg/kms/region_binding.go and a lightweight region-prover client used only by the middleware to annotate audits; the prover supports a circuit-breaker and graceful fallback (soft-fail). - Add config schema changes and a k8s patch (deploy/k8s/patches/decision-cache-config.yaml) to expose runtime knobs: cache_ttl_ms, max_entries, soft_fail_behavior (allow/deny/log-only). - Add docs/security/rbacv2-decision-cache.md and examples for operators. - Add integration tests that exercise cache eviction, revocation, and the soft-fail auditing path. Commits: ["feat(rbac): add decision cache implementation and metrics facade","feat(audit): obligation middleware to attach KMS residency evidence","chore(config): add decision-cache runtime knobs and default values","test(integration): add cache+revocation tests and kms soft-fail scenarios","docs: rbacv2 decision cache and operator guidance"]
review_comments: Priya: This looks good overall. Two requests: (1) please add an explicit metric for 'cache_miss_decisions' tagged by tenant and route; (2) document operator migration steps when enabling the feature.
Marcel (author): Added cache_miss_decisions and updated docs; the migration section suggests a canary on 10% traffic and an observational period of 48hrs. See latest commit.
Liam: I am worried about stale decisions when a policy changes quickly. Can we wire in a policy-version tag into the cache key?
Marcel: Good catch — cache keys now include policy_sha and rollouts are invalidated by publishing a 'policy.pushed' event. Added revocation hook to listen to the PD service.
Zoe: Approve after CI passes and an e2e test that simulates KMS-prover outage with soft-fail=config=log-only.

notes_for_ops: Default is OFF. Operators must opt-in at service level by setting feature.gates.rbac_decision_cache.enabled=true
When enabling, start with cache_ttl_ms=250 and max_entries=5000; observe cache_hit_ratio and cache_miss_decisions metrics
For strict compliance environments set soft_fail_behavior=deny; default recommended for SaaS is log-only to avoid hard failures during prover outages
Policy push events trigger cache invalidation; ensure PD service is configured to publish policy.pushed events to the revocation webhook endpoint
audit_backward_compatibility: The audit envelope format is additive. Existing consumers will ignore the new 'kms_residency_evidence' attribute. We added a version tag 'audit_schema_v=2' when the middleware is enabled to help downstream compatibility checks.
